b.why: the corridor's own bounding box padded by 0.004 deg (~440 m), which is a superset of an around:150 pull over the same corridor; the 150 m proximity test was then applied locally. overpass-api.de refused the 1139-point around: query (HTTP 406) and then timed out; kumi.systems returned 504.

census.note: Re-derived from pull b with the repo's own etl.snap - the kernel the shipped code uses - independently of the numbers in byway_route_key's docstring.

the_withdrawn_second_column.what_it_claimed_to_be: a SECOND, INDEPENDENT Overpass pull agreeing with the first to a rounding - byway_route_key's docstring ran it as a two-column table
the_withdrawn_second_column.what_it_actually_is: the same two pulls under a hand-rolled flat-earth segment length in the scratch script that measured the census, instead of snap.distance_on_earth - the instrument, not the data
the_withdrawn_second_column.how_that_was_established: both pulls were run through both kernels: each kernel gives the same numbers to the digit on BOTH pulls, and the only pull-to-pull difference is 302 vs 306 ways within 150 m of the corridor
